recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless extension ownership moves back into core; any future wording correction for codesystem-sourceReference should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It originally asked that codesystem-sourceReference and codesystem-authoritativeSource reference each other and clarify their difference, but the final 2024-03-25 resolution was to deprecate codesystem-sourceReference.
initial_application: No FHIR core commit was found that applies FHIR-40739, and current core source has no active fhir.ini or StructureDefinition source for codesystem-sourceReference or codesystem-authoritativeSource. The implementation trail is in HL7/fhir-extensions: commit 2d8d674 added deprecated standards-status markers, d0ac764 added rationale text, and ea2d7b0 made codesystem-sourceReference retired with an explicit deprecation reason.
additional_context: The 2024-03-25 Vocabulary minutes confirm that the group considered the sourceReference description nonsensical and resolved to deprecate the extension. The same minutes discuss FHIR-40730 for codesystem-authoritativeSource, which was also resolved for deprecation, so the original request to cross-reference and distinguish the two extensions is superseded by retiring/deprecating the maintained Extension Pack definitions. Core still only has OID registrations for these URLs.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined FHIR core branch. No core source change was made because the active extension definition is external to this checkout and already reflects the Jira resolution.
